recordType: Observed development-run failures and their resolution; historical evidence, not the current verification result

observations.stage: First complete native-question browser run, file:// Fraction Matcher startup
observations.message: Failed to execute 'insertRule' on 'CSSStyleSheet': Cannot access StyleSheet to insertRule
observations.cause: Pinned legacy SceneryStyle selected the last document stylesheet, which was the later body theme.css link rather than its own head inline style.
observations.resolution: A reversible display-only build patch selects the created inline style's own sheet. Dedicated phet-display-compat-browser checks cover HTTP/file and delayed startup. The final native run passes five genuinely offline file representatives.

observations.message: TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON
observations.cause: A native balance-direction enumeration object was copied into diagnostic proof.
observations.resolution: Proof records the enumeration's stable name. The final report writes successfully and retains zero browser errors.

observations.observation: The native Area Builder goal showed 24 while an earlier teaching card still showed 9 during the 150ms polling interval.
observations.cause: The capture wait checked only contextId, which stays the same on a native restart.
observations.resolution: Capture now waits until the panel fingerprint equals the current native challenge fingerprint, then settles fonts and two animation frames. All 69 final image paths were regenerated.
